page.layout: One page of text (left printed page), running head at top, text block in the centre; at the right edge the gutter of the facing page shows fragments of another page (its running head "D", a heading "H." and lines of text) which are cut off by the scan edge and are not transcribed as part of this page's text. Below the text a centred heading "CAPVT" in capitals.

main_text.p: Quoniam summa maior à posteriore in mutuum peſtita eſt: ideò eam citiùs reſtituere tenebitur, quàm prior, cuius summa minor fuerat. Vnde reciprocatio concluſdetur tali poſitione:
¶ 4. Ita etiam exemplum quintum, capitis decimi quinti, de 126 Hungaricis ducatis, ſingulos 28 urſatis æſtimando, in Taleros, 18 urſatis taxatos, redigendis, tractari & abſolui potuit, hoc modo:
main_text.head: CAPVT

page.notes: Right-hand facing page is cut off at the scan edge; only fragments visible, not transcribed. Fraction "4 1/8" is printed as a stacked fraction. Printed "tractari" appears as "tractari" with a ligature; "vrsatis" read as "urſatis" per print.
